newsitem.title: USA: Clinton vows veto over aid for disabled immigrants.
newsitem.headline: Clinton vows veto over aid for disabled immigrants.

text.p: President Clinton vowed on Friday to veto budget legislation that does not restore Medicaid health and other government benefits to disabled legal immigrants.

"It is essential that the legislation that is presented to me include these provisions," Clinton said in a letter to House Budget Committee Chairman John Kasich. "I will be unable to sign legislation that does not."
The president said Congressional leaders had already agreed in their budget pact to restore those benefits to disabled legal immigrants who entered the United States before Aug. 23, 1996.
"I want to stress this issue to be of paramount importance," Clinton said.
He nevertheless voiced confidence that the United States will enact legislation to balance the budget, noting that good progress is being made on many issues.
